capabilities: Build equations by clicking fraction, root, integral, matrix, and system templates
Edit formulas in visual, LaTeX, or side-by-side hybrid mode and save as $…$/$$…$$ Markdown
Plot functions, polar curves, 3D surfaces, and complex points below equations
Write chemical reactions with balance checks and insert physics formulas
Convert units offline and look up periodic table elements
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; GPL v3.0 only with Obsidian linking exception since 0.7.0; runs fully offline with no telemetry; main documentation lives on the author's website and YouTube channel.
intentEvidence: I built Visual Math so you can write math, chemistry, and physics notes in Obsidian without typing raw LaTeX by hand every time.
motivation: The author built it so users can write math, chemistry, and physics notes in Obsidian without typing raw LaTeX by hand every time.
problem: Obsidian math requires typing raw LaTeX by hand, and there is no built-in visual editor, function plotter, or unit converter for scientific notes.

relations.evidence: Bundled MathLive, Convert, KaTeX fonts (MIT), and mhchem (Apache 2.0) notices are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
Chemistry (\ce{…}) and units (\pu{…}) require host mhchem support when exported outside Obsidian.

summary: Visual equation editor that builds math, chemistry and physics notation by clicking templates instead of typing LaTeX, with offline graphing and unit tools.
